choices.content: The diagonals are perpendicular to each other

question.prompt: Which of the following properties does a rhombus have that a general parallelogram does not necessarily have?

solutions.explanation: Parallel opposite sides, equal opposite angles, and diagonals that bisect each other are common properties of parallelograms. Perpendicular diagonals are a property specific to rhombuses.
solutions.title: Compare rhombus and parallelogram properties
